metadata.title: Call of Duty Coach Aggregate Stats
metadata.purpose: Aggregated data designed to power a coach-facing narrative report from raw Call of Duty match exports.
notes: Coach team is identified by the roster Manny, Okis, SkiL, and Swooty.
Objective fields are retained as context but are not built into a single heavy objective score.
Scores are preserved in raw form because Overload scores may be numeric or time formatted.

importantDerivedMetrics.killShare: player kills / team kills in the same match
importantDerivedMetrics.damageShare: player damage / team damage in the same match
importantDerivedMetrics.deathShare: player deaths / team deaths in the same match

recommendedNarrativeUsage: Use coachTeam.overall and coachTeam.splits first for the team story.
Use coachPlayers.overall and coachPlayers.splits for player cards.
Use rankings.lobby for light opponent benchmarks.
Use matchSummaries only when the narrative needs specific game examples.

coachPlayerRoleHints.Okis: Main slaying anchor candidate: leads coach team in K/D, KA/D, damage per game, non-traded kill percentage, and average highest streak.
coachPlayerRoleHints.Swooty: Pressure player candidate: high damage and kill volume, but highest deaths per game among coach team.
coachPlayerRoleHints.SkiL: Stable slayer candidate: positive K/D and solid kill volume, with lower assist/objective footprint.
coachPlayerRoleHints.Manny: Support/objective hybrid candidate: lower slaying volume, but solid KA/D and meaningful objective context.

interpretationGuardrails: Objective data should be used as context, not as the main ranking factor.
Small sample size; phrase findings as signals or coaching questions, not absolute conclusions.
Opponent data is included mainly for benchmarking and context.
